result_text:
The export now builds `all_files.zip` from the configured aspect names, so renaming `buildAndDeployment` no longer breaks the zip or `git-history.zip`.

**What changed:** `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/dataexporters/DataExporter.java`, in `exportZips()`. Instead of five hard-coded `aspect_*.txt` literals, it takes the five configured aspects in the same order (main, test, generated, build and deployment, other). For each one it gets the entry name from `DataExportUtils.getAspectFileListFileName(aspect, "")`, the same helper that names the loose files, and reads that file. I also added the `NamedSourceCodeAspect` import.

**Why it failed before:** the literal `aspect_build_and_deployment.txt` no longer existed once the aspect was renamed. The `FileNotFoundException` was swallowed by the `catch (Throwable t)` in `exportJson()`, which skipped `exportZips()` entirely. That is why `git-history.zip` was also missing.

**Default output is unchanged:** `build and deployment` still maps to `aspect_build_and_deployment.txt`, and the entries stay in the same order. With `buildAndDeployment` the fourth entry becomes `aspect_buildAndDeployment.txt`.

**Verification:** `mvn -q -o -pl reports test` passes. I did not add a test or run the CLI against a renamed config, so the renamed-aspect result rests on reading the naming code rather than an end-to-end run. Nothing is committed.
